subject: 84bcf8b7-6125-4338-b448-81bc3cdb2674
object: British mathematician (1912–1954).  Formalized the concept of computation with the Turing machine (1936), proving the halting problem undecidable — the computational echo of Gödel's incompleteness.  Broke the Enigma code at Bletchley Park.  Proposed the Turing test for machine intelligence.  Prosecuted for homosexuality, died of cyanide poisoning at 41.
